rav-ukva-bar-chama.name: Rav Ukva bar Ḥama
rav-ukva-bar-chama.bio: Babylonian Amora; on this daf he raises an objection to Abaye’s explanation of Rabbi Elazar.
rav-ukva-bar-chama.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a dark, close-trimmed beard and a plain brown wool cloak, raising one finger to press an objection; background of a Babylonian study house with mudbrick walls and oil lamps.

mar-zutra-brei-derav-mari.name: Mar Zutra, son of Rav Mari
mar-zutra-brei-derav-mari.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Mari, cited here in discussion with Ravina.
mar-zutra-brei-derav-mari.prompt: A scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a striped Babylonian mantle, nodding in agreement as he turns toward a colleague; background of a reed-roofed study hall beside a canal.
